newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 7.22 pct at Italy lira repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 7.22 pct at Italy lira repo tender.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 5.5 trillion lire 17-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 7.22 percent, compared with 7.41 percent at the previous repo tender on April 11, the Bank said.
The average rate was 7.23 percent against 7.42 percent at the last repurchase pact for 11.0 trillion lire and four days.
The pact covers purchases today and the securities are for resale on May 2. The Bank said it received 38 bids of which four were met in full and three in part.
